scope: DeliveryProof and immutable lifecycle events reject re-signed non-parseable timestamps

tests: rejects a re-signed proof with an invalid issued timestamp
rejects a re-signed proof event with an invalid created timestamp
redEvidence.beforeFix: Both re-signed records were accepted as semantically valid; an invalid event timestamp was treated as a valid revocation.

boundary: The timestamp guard is semantic and fail-closed; fingerprint integrity, artifact byte verification, revocation, and supersession checks remain independently enforced.
